_comment: Fixture for the video-transcription (ASR) evidence pair: a vault whose ONLY provider is
Anthropic, plus the four ASR settings fields this change adds to Settings -> Capture.
The active provider is deliberately 'anthropic'. Before this change, transcription was
gated on activeProvider.type === 'openai-compatible', so a vault like this one could not
transcribe at all -- that gate is what the change removes. The asr* keys below are read
by the After revision and simply ignored by the Before revision, so both phases run on
byte-identical data.json and the pair differs only by the feature under test.
asrApiKey is deliberately empty so the After capture shows the '(reuse provider key)'
placeholder, i.e. the zero-migration default, while the other three show configured values.
Keys a bitmap cannot reveal (the provider API key) are marked _unverified.

_unverified.apiKey: only its presence is inferable from the card badge; the value is a fixture
